subject: Confirming budget holder & procurement path for pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@mindbridge.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: stakeholders & budget owner from today's demo

Hi Tara —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Short recap and two quick asks so we can scope the trial and get procurement moving:  

1) What we heard: primary evaluation is clinical chart summarization integrated into your QA workflows. Success metric: 75% reduction in manual triage time for care coaches.
2) Proposed pilot: 30-day sandbox, up to 50k generated tokens/day, PHI-safe ingress with audit logging enabled.

Two asks to keep momentum:  
- Please confirm the economic/budget owner (name + email) we should include for approvals.
- Who handles SOW/PO intake and any procurement constraints (data residency, DPAs, or unusual vendor terms)?

I attached a one-page MAP that maps milestones and a suggested timeline. If you confirm the buyer and procurement contact, I will update the MAP with proposed dates and send an invite for a short alignment call.

Thanks — happy to tailor the kickoff materials to whoever you want involved.

— Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-trial-MAP-20260602.pdf (1 page)

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@mindbridge.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@mindbridge.ai>, procurement@mindbridge.ai
Date: 2026-06-02T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: stakeholders & budget owner from today's demo

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear MAP. Answers below:  

- Economic owner: Amit Rao, Head of Platform (amit.rao@mindbridge.ai) — he owns platform tooling budgets.
- Procurement intake: procurement@mindbridge.ai (copied). They prefer a short SOW + our standard NDA up front. Finance will need a short cost justification packet for anything over $5k.

I'll loop Amit in so he can confirm headroom. For security/compliance, we run a standard vendor questionnaire; happy to connect your security lead with ours.

Proposed next step: 15-min intro with Amit + procurement next week (Tue or Wed morning PT).

Thanks,
Tara Singh
Director of Clinical Ops | MindBridge Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Rao <amit.rao@mindbridge.ai>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@mindbridge.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, procurement@mindbridge.ai
Date: 2026-06-03T08:54:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + proposed MAP and times (pilot kickoff)

Hi Amit — thanks for joining the thread. Per Tara, it sounds like you are the right person for budget approval. Short note on the plan and asks:  

- Goal: 30-day pilot focused on chart summarization (clinician QA) with measurable triage time reduction.
- Ballpark pilot cost for approvals: ~$7,000 for sandbox capacity + onboarding support (detailed line items in MAP).
- Procurement: we need a PO or SOW to begin; procurement@mindbridge.ai is copied.

Can you confirm: 1) budget approval for ~$7k pilot; 2) preferred SOW/PO contact and any lead-time constraints? If helpful I can draft a 1-pager for leadership that summarizes value and expected KPIs.

Proposed times (PT) for a 15-min sync: Tue 2026-06-09 9:30–9:45, Wed 2026-06-10 10:00–10:15. Let me know which works and I will send a calendar invite and a clean SOW draft.

— Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-trial-MAP-20260602.pdf (updated)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-03T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro + proposed MAP and times (pilot kickoff)

Evelyn — forwarding the thread. MindBridge asked about security artifacts and their procurement team prefers a short SOW + NDA. Can you:  

- Pull a SOC 2 summary, one-page data handling note for a limited pilot, and a short list of what we can commit to during a 30-day sandbox (log retention, access controls, PHI handling).
- Call out any items that would extend onboarding lead time (e.g., additional attestation, specific regional hosting).

If you want, I can join the security call. Waiting on Amit to confirm budget/timing before booking the kickoff.

Thanks — Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Amit Rao <amit.rao@mindbridge.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@mindbridge.ai>
Cc: procurement@mindbridge.ai
Date: 2026-06-05T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed MAP and times (pilot kickoff)

Jordan/Tara —

Confirming I am the budget owner and we have headroom for a ~$7k pilot this quarter. Procurement will handle the SOW/PO; they prefer a short SOW and our standard NDAs up front. Procurement has attached our vendor contact card to the thread.

Wed 2026-06-10 at 10:00 PT works for the 15-min sync. Jordan — please send the one-pager and a clean SOW draft; procurement will convert to a PO once we sign. Also please include a brief bullet list of expected KPIs so finance can justify the spend.

Cheers,
Amit Rao
Head of Platform | MindBridge Health
Attachment: mindbridge-procurement-contacts.vcf (contact card)
